notes: Rows paraphrase the published charts and add design prompts; high-number bands are thematic, not direct quotations.
The printed Noir chart overlaps 16-20 and 20-25. For software nonoverlap, the latter is normalized to 21-25.
A result of 71 or above is a potential finale, not an automatic forced campaign end.

noir.title: Unexpected warning
noir.progress: An estranged ally sends an encrypted alert.
noir.result: Reveal or introduce an NPC Contact.

noir.title: Suspicious funeral
noir.progress: Someone close dies under a dubious account.
noir.result: Find who is concealing the cause.

noir.title: Old debt
noir.progress: A party member is pressed to settle a concealed obligation.

noir.title: Disrupted routine
noir.progress: A mundane system or supply chain has a hidden discrepancy.
noir.result: Follow the records to a deeper conspiracy.

noir.title: Ambiguous benefactor
noir.progress: A stranger offers a contract with unspoken stakes.
noir.result: Learn the true sponsor and motive.

noir.title: Private danger
noir.progress: Someone with a tie to the characters faces exposure.
noir.result: Identify who is manipulating the situation.

noir.title: Pressure mounts
noir.progress: An official investigation or surveillance closes in.
noir.result: Protect a lead while the opposition tightens control.

noir.title: Missing connection
noir.progress: A reliable person or access point suddenly vanishes.
noir.result: Locate the missing contact and identify their captor.
noir.finale: Rescue someone whose disappearance threatens the case.

noir.title: Scene destroyed
noir.progress: An important location is sabotaged or stripped of evidence.
noir.result: Recover evidence before the trail is lost.
noir.finale: Protect someone trapped by the destruction.

noir.title: Betrayal exposed
noir.progress: An ally has been secretly working against the crew.
noir.result: Find the precise point at which trust failed.

noir.title: Bigger players
noir.progress: The inquiry reveals a powerful organization behind the affair.
noir.result: Choose whom to expose or how to gain leverage.
noir.finale: Take decisive action against institutional cover.

noir.title: Syndicate crackdown
noir.progress: An entrenched criminal force treats the party as a threat.
noir.finale: Destroy the operation or erase the party’s trace.

noir.title: Judgment
noir.progress: A trusted figure double-crosses the characters from an unreachable position.
noir.finale: Expose or remove the protected betrayer.

noir.title: Closing net
noir.progress: The characters lose options, allies and time.
noir.result: Find one narrow escape from coordinated pressure.
noir.finale: Take an extreme risk before the window closes.

noir.title: Catastrophic reveal
noir.progress: The accumulated conspiracy bursts into open violence.
noir.finale: Resolve the conspiracy at terrible personal cost.

action.title: Easy mission, hidden cost
action.result: Question whether the team missed the real objective.

action.title: Surprise stealth
action.progress: An adversary unexpectedly fails to detect the team.

action.title: Collateral consequences
action.progress: The team harms the wrong target.
action.result: An unwanted Scandal follows the party.

action.title: Odd weapon
action.progress: The enemy uses unfamiliar equipment or insignia.
action.result: Trace the supplier or capture the prototype.

action.title: Escalating pursuit
action.progress: A routine operation draws a more dangerous response.

action.title: Hostile intervention
action.progress: A third party moves against the crew.
action.result: Decide whether to fight, negotiate or evade.

action.title: Operational betrayal
action.progress: A tactical partner changes sides at a critical point.

action.title: Team member taken
action.progress: Sensitive intelligence leaks and someone goes missing.
action.result: Find the team member before interrogation begins.
action.finale: Recover the captive and contain the leak.

action.title: Retaliation
action.progress: An allied base suffers a deliberate attack.
action.result: Find the perpetrators and account for casualties.

action.title: Supply crisis
action.progress: A major equipment or logistical dependency collapses.
action.result: Secure a replacement amid hostile surveillance.
action.finale: Protect the last viable resupply channel.

action.title: Attack on allies
action.progress: An enemy singles out the party’s support network.
action.finale: Prevent the next strike on sympathetic contacts.

action.title: Command disruption
action.progress: The opposition has centralized command and coordination.

action.title: Deep betrayal
action.progress: An influential sponsor is actively manipulating the fighting.
action.result: Find proof before the team is framed.
action.finale: Remove the sponsor without being destroyed politically.

action.title: Special weapon threat
action.progress: A specialist weapon or unit is deployed against the party.
action.finale: Stop deployment or defeat the special force.

action.title: War of attrition
action.progress: A prolonged conflict threatens everyone in its reach.
action.result: Choose a path through devastating losses.
action.finale: End the conflict or survive its annihilation.
